tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rab gnas kyi cho ga don gnyis lhun grub blo gsal dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ya/ bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos rje dang / /gang gi rigs sras grub mchog dbang po'i zhabs/ /sbas pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal sras grags pa'i mtshan/ /rigs kun khyab bdag mus pa chen po sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gus btud nas/ /rab gnas cho ga don gnyis lhun grub 'di/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir ngas bshad kyi/ /don gnyer blo gsal rnams kyi dga' ston mdzod/ /de la 'dir sdom ni/ rten gyi bya ba yongs rdzogs nas/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid gnas dang dus/ /yo byad yongs su tshang nas ni/ /cho ga dag la 'jug par bya/ /zhes pa'i don tshan drug phan yon dang bcas pa'i rnam gzhag gzhan rnams ni rje btsun gyi don gsal dang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i dngos grub 'byung ba sogs las rtogs par bya zhing / 'dir don tshan drug pa cho ga la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ 'bring po'i phyag len gyi rdo rje'i bdag bskyed dang sbyar nas bshad par bya ste/ de yang / legs bsham bdag bskyed bum pa bzlas/ /rten sbyangs bkru zhing phyi ba dang / /ring bsrel gzhug cing gsol ba gdab/ /rten bskyed spyan drangs dgug rgyas gdab/ /dbang bskur mchod bstod spyan dbye dang / /gsal gdab mnga' dbul rgyas par bya/ /de yang mchod bstod chog ga dang / /sbyin sreg sngags te dngos gzhi 'o/ /zhes pa ltar las/ thog mar legs par bshams bshams ni/ ji ltar 'os pa'i gnas su phyag dar dang bla bre dar gyi lda ldi 'phan sogs ci 'byor pas brgyan pa'i bar yi dam chos skyong gi bris 'bur sku gang 'byor rab gnas can bzhugs pa'i mdun stegs la/ dam rdzas dang bskang gso sogs gang dgos kyi gtor ma mchod pa dang bcas pa rang rang gi phyag len bzhin dang / rten gsar pa gos dar sogs ser pos g.yogs pa'i mdun du stegs gang 'gab la/

chu bzhi'i sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang / gzhan yang me tog spos/ mar me/ yon chab/ zhal zas rnams ji ltar 'byor pa phreng tshar du bkod pa mdzes par bshams/ 'di dag gtsang zhing rgya che ba rang byung na bzang ste rgyas pa'i las dang bsod nams bsog pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir ro/ /logs gcig tu mchod pa kha gso ba'i yo byad kyi mchod 'bru/ mar me/ zhal zas rnams 'khob tshod bzhag rten gsar pa'i mdun ji ltar rigs par ras ser po la sogs pa'i gzhi bzang po bting ba'i steng du/ ras ser po la chu tshon gyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte bar rin po che dgu pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la bkra shis rtags brgyad bris pa'i khrus stegs dgram pa'i dbus su mañji la sogs pa'i khar/ gser dngul ra gan la sogs pa rin po che'i khrus gzhong bu ga dang bral ba'i nang du/ rten rgya gar ma la sogs la rnying pa chung ngu rab gnas can li ma la sogs pa chu'i skyon mi 'byung ba'am/ sangs rgyas ring bsrel lam rdo rje la sogs pa gang rung bzhag pa/ de dang nye bar maṇ+ḍal la gur gum dang / gi ham̐ bsres pa'i dri bzang gi chus oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bid+ya swāhā/ rten 'brel snying po rnams bris pa bzhag 'di 'og gi khrus long byed rgyu yin/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du dri'i bum pa ste pad+ma re'i steng du g.yas skor gyi khrus bum brgyad po/ kha rgyan/ mgul chings/ nang rdzas ni dri'i bum par tsan+dan dkar dmar/ gur gum sogs dri bzang gang 'byor/ mngar gsum la ka ra/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi gang 'byor/ zho'i bum par zho dkris med pa cung zad/ 'bras bu'i bum par a bar skyur gsum sogs gang 'byor/ 'bru'i bum par/ nas gro 'bras sran sogs 'bru'i rigs/ 'bras yos kyi bum par 'bras brngos pa'am/ phyag len la lho nas 'ong ba'i 'bras phal sgye zer ba'i 'bras leb mo 'di la mdzad par snang bar gang bde'o/ /sman gyi bum par bzang drug

kan+da ka ri/ dbang lag sogs gang 'byor/ rin po che'i bum par gser/ dngul byu ru sogs rin po che'i rigs gang rnyed de/ bum rdzas de rnams zhib par btags la dri bzang gi chu dang bsres nas bum pa so so'i nang du ma nor bar sum cha tsam blug la/ mchu rnams dbus su bstan te bzhag yang khrus bum brgyad ye ma 'byor na bum pa gcig tu bum rdzas brgyad char blugs pa/ rang gi mdun las bum gyi 'khris su bum stan 'dab brgyad ma bzhag pas kyang rung / khrus stegs kyi gang 'os su ting la sogs pa'i snod la gtsang mar snum la dri bzang btab pa/ yang snod cig tu rgya nag nas 'byung ba'i sran dkar ram/ de ma 'byor na dbus su skyes pa'i rgya sran dkar po rjen btags byas pa'i sran dkar gyi phye ma de dang / dri bzang gi chu bsres pa'i lde gu de gnyis maṇ+ḍal la byugs pa'i ras la sogs pa gtsang ma'i pir re so sor bcug pa/ sku'i srub brang phyis byed pa'i tshul gyi dur ba'i chun po/ ga ḍu ba la sogs pa bshal chu'i chu gtsang ma/ ras sam dar dkar po la dri'i thig le lnga'am/ rigs lnga'i sa bon bris pa'i sku phyis/ khrus long ni gong du bshams zin/ bgegs zhi bas sbyang ba'i gtor ma gsum ni/ phyag len la bgegs gtor mtheb kyu 'dra ba gsum la dkar rgyan brgyab pa/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba'i ting lo dang chang bu sbrags pa gsum/ drag pos sbyang ba'i gu gul sogs/ sdig pa sbyang ba'i til rnams phyag len bzhin dang / slob dpon gyi mdun du/ rdo dril nang mchod gos zung rnams dang / bum stan pad+ma 'dab brgyad gnyis la/ rnam rgyal dang las bum mgul chings/ kha rgyan/ bum mtshan/ nang rdzas sogs kye rdor dbang chu bzhin dang / 'thor nas snod dang bcas pa/ dpon slob mang du yod na thams cad kyi mdun du/ rdo dril/ nang mchod/ rnga/ cha lang / dung sogs dgos pa'i yo byad tshang ba dang / gzhan yang gong du bshad pa'i khrus stegs kyi g.yon phyogs gang 'os su/

mnga' dbul gyi stegs ras la sogs pa la/ ri rab gling bzhi bri ba ni/ phyogs re re la cha lnga lnga ste bcu par byas/ dbus kyi cha gnyis la pad 'dab brgyad bris/ phyi rol gyis zur nas bskor la lcags ri bya/ phyogs bzhi nas byang chub mchod rten gyi bang rim ltar je chung je chung byas pa'i ri rab bang rim bzhi pa/ shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ser po/ zur bzhi'i re mig rnams sngon po/ de'i phyi rol lcags ri'i nang rgya mtsho mtshon byed chu ris bris pa'i steng shar du zla gam gsum/ lhor sog kha gsum/ nub tu zlum bu gsum/ byang du gru bzhi gsum ste gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ de dag gi g.yas g.yon du shar du dpal be'u dang / 'khor lo/ lhor pad+ma dang / rgyal mtshan/ nub tu gdugs dang / bum pa/ byang du dung dang / gser nya ste bkra shis rtags brgyad/ phyi lcags ri sngon po rnams bri'o/ /de ltar bris pa de nyid ras la sogs pa gzhi bzang po'i steng du dgram pa'i dbus kyi pad 'dab brgyad kyi steng du gser ram/ dngul gyi phor ba la sogs pa rin po che'i snod kyi nang du 'bru sna tshogs dang / gser dngul byu ru/ mu tig la sogs pa ci 'byor pas phyur mor bkang pa bzhag slob dpon gyi mdun stegs ji ltar rigs par/ stegs la rten la dbang bskur ba'i rdor dril/ dbu rgyan/ mnga' dbul gyi tsa ka li rgyab yig can gang dgos/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ chos skyong bsgo ba'i gtor ma che ba/ gong du bstan pa'i gtor ma rnams kyis 'khris gang bder bzhag gzhan yang tsa ru'i bza' ba phyag len bzhin bshams pa sogs mdor na dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad ma tshang ba med pa sta gon bya'o/ /de nas nangs par tho rangs snga bar langs te/ gos ser po gyon nas stan la 'dug ste gnas yo byin rlabs kye rdor dbang chu bzhin byas/ dang po bdag bskyed pa ni/ lam dus rgyas pa byas nas dkyil 'khor bsdus te he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa'i bar bya/

de nas bum pa sgrub pa ni/ rnam rgyal dang las bum dkyil chog ltar bsgrubs nas/ khrus bum gcig las med na/ de'i steng du rdo rje gzung thag bzhag la/ gzungs thag mchu la bskor te slob dpon gyis bzung / yang khrus bum brgyad yod kyang / khrus stegs thag ring na rang gi mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs par nas la sogs pa'i pad 'dab brgyad kyi steng du bkod/ dri'i bum pa'i steng du rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa bzhag gzungs thag gi khrus bum thams cad kyi mchu la bskor nas bzhag pa la las bum gyi chu ku shas khrus bum rnams la gtor te/ oṃ mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rum̐ las rin po che'i bum pa rnams yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang so so'i rdzas kyis yongs su gang bar gyur/ ces brjod cing slob dpon gyis gzungs thag nas blang ste dri'i bum pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dha snā na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ de bzhin du sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las/ mngar gsum bum pa la gan+dha'i gnas su tri ma dhu dang / zho'i bum pa la/ ma la dang / 'bras bu'i bum pa la/ pha la dang / 'bru'i bum pa la/ bru hi dang / 'bras yos kyi bum pa la/ lardza dang / sman gyi bum pa la/ o ṣa dhi dang / rin po che'i bum pa la/ ma ṇi rnams 'don pa bsgyur zhing sbyar ba lan nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzlas/ thun mong du gtsug tor rnal rgyal gyi gzungs ring tshar gsum/ gzungs ring dang / khrus bum gyi sngags brgyad kar/ dpon slob mang po yod na bsgrigs 'don mdzad/ de nas las thams cad pa'i sngags/ a mṛ ta ci nus bzlas tshar ba dang / nang rdzas rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i so so'i bum pa rten gyi dri ma sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

ces brjod cing gzungs thag bsdu'o/ /de nas rten sbyang ba la gnyis/ bgegs sbyang ba dang sdig pa sbyang ba'o/ /dang po la zhi bas sbyang ba/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba/ drag pos sbyang ba gsum las/ dang po rten la g.yogs pa'i dar la sogs pa dang / kha kheb rnams bsal la/ dpon slob rnams dbu zhwa bzhes nas bzhengs te/ gong du bshams pa'i gtor ma gtor theb la sogs pa'i snod gsum gyi nang du bzhag pa sbyang stegs kyi steng du bshams/ de rnams kyi sreg tu ting lo dang chang bu sbrags pa gsum po yang rim pa bzhin ting lo rnams sbar la bzhag gtor ma gsum chus bran la mchod g.yog pas gtor ma gsum re re bzhin rten gsar ma rnams la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba'i tshul bya zhing / dpon slob thams cad kyi phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya g.yas phyogs bskor zhing / mthar se gol gtogs la byin rlabs mi dgos pas/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu ge bh+yeḥsarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā dī swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ mchod g.yog pas gtor ma rnams snod gcig tu bsags/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis shig ces brjod/ gnyis pa zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba ni ting lo dang chang bu rten la mchod g.yog pas gong bzhin bskor zhing / mchod g.yog pas 'khris su bzhag dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje gsor zhing / sam+bha ni bzlas pa lan gsum byas la mchod g.yog pas gtor ma dang ting lo sogs phyi rol tu dor/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma lam brngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig

ces brjod/ gsum pa drag pos sbyang ba ni/ dpon slob rnams khro bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas rdo rje dril bu dang / slob dpon gyis spos thogs te/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo me ltar 'bar ba la ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kro dhā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes brjod cing gdangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad bsregs/ /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal/ /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra mahā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥspos bzhag oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ mahā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+gham̐/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ dril bsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing / thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa/ /khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras/ /ma lus dbang du bsdus la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing / /bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa/ /sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyangs bskums tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/

/bgegs dpung bsreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog /khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa tshar gcig dang / 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog shing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces sh+lau ka gcig po lan gsum brjod/ de nas dpon slob rnams kyis kye rdo rje'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi rnams bka' bden pa dang / dpal mgon chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la/ bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas des tshim par gyis la/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig gal te mi 'gro ba thams cad la dus gsum gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal ba brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes drag tu brjod la/ rten rnams gu gul gyis bdugs/ yungs dkar dang nas bsres pas brabs/ sna tshogs pa'i rol mo drag tu bya zhing / rtsa sngags/ aṣ+ṭa/

dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags/ a mṛ ta/ sogs drag sngags gang shes mang du bzlas/ sems kyis bgegs thams cad phyi rol tu bros par bsam mo/ /de 'dra ba lan gsum bya/ gnyis pa sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ mchod g.yog pas mdun du til/ g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu bzhag til mchod g.yog pa'i lag mthil gnyis su blugs la/ rten gsar pa la kha phyogs pas/ lag pa g.yas pas g.yas dang / g.yon gyis g.yon du bskor/ gnyis ka gshibs la g.yas g.yon du bskor zhing / mthar lag pa bsnol te g.yas kyi me dang / g.yon gyi chu sngags dang bstun nas dor/ de bzhin lan gsum byas te/ g.yas kyi ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ g.yon gyi rgya mtshos bkrus par bsams la/ dpon slob rnams kyis ngag tu/ bdag dang yon bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa rnams snying khar yi ge kam̐ nag po'i rnam par gnas pa sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par thon nas mdun gyi til la thim pa de nyid/ g.yas su ye shes kyi mes bsregs shing / g.yon du rgya mtsho'i chus bkrus par gyur/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhas smin ku ru swāhā/ zhes sngags lan gsum brjod cing / mchod g.yog pas chu de'i khar me de nas cung zad blugs te rgya mtsho chen por dor bar bsam la phyi rol tu gtor/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ bdag dang yon bdag gis gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas bkru shing phyi ba ni/ rten gsar pa la khrus bya ba'i sngon du khrus stegs kyi steng gi rten sogs dang / me long gi yig 'bru rnams las bum gyi chus mchod g.yog pas bkru zhing / sku phyis phrag pa g.yon par bkal la/ dpon slob rnams kyis dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / 'dir ni khrus mchog sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/

/rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang pa'i glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du ma'i sku khrus gsol/ /zhes brjod cing sna tshogs rol mo bya/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs gsum ga'i mjug tu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ mchod g.yog pas bum chus sngags rnams dag par bkrus shing / rten rnams ring bsrel lam rdo rje gang yin la khrus long gi chu de 'phog par bya'o/ /de nas mchod g.yog pas sku phyis phrag pa g.yon nas phab ste me long nang du sku sogs gzugs brnyan shar ba de phyis par bsam la dpon slob rnams kyis/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ tram̐ḥhrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi shwa dha ne swāhā/ zhes pas sku phyis par bsam mo/ /de nas khrus stegs sku'am rdo rje sogs stegs ji ltar rigs par bzhugs su gsol/ khrus chu de khrus bum brgyad por bgos la/ de nas rten gsar pa spyan drangs su btub cing chus skyon mi yong ba rnams khrus stegs su spyan drangs nas dngos su bkru bar gsungs kyang / bla ma rnams phyag len 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir/ de rnams khrus long gi ngos la sku'i gzugs brnyan rnams shar bar mos pa byas la/ mchod g.yog pas khrus stegs kyi 'khris su tsog pur 'dug la/ lag pa g.yon gyi khrus long dang / g.yas kyi rdzas snum sogs dang / khrus chu rnams tshig dang bstun nas bku mnye brad pa'i tshul dang / bkru zhing bum chu rnams khrus gzhong gi nang du yong bar bya/ sku phyis kyang gong dang 'dra/ de nas mchod g.yog pas snum la dri bzang btab pa nas pir gyis blangs/ dpon slob rnams gdangs dang bcas/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i lus sems sdug bsngal bsal slad du/ /chu gtsang sman spos 'dag chal 'dis bkrus pas/ /bdag cag dam pa'i sku mchog thob par shog

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya bi shwo dha ne swāhā/ zhes sngags lan gsum brjod cing / dang po la mchod g.yog pas me long nang gi sku gzugs la bku mnye byed par bsam zhing / dri bzang btab pa'i snum me long la byugs/ sngags gnyis pa la sran dkar gyi 'dag chal gyis byug cing mnye bar bsam/ sngags gsum pa la dur ba'i chun po me long la drud cing sku'i srub rnams brad par bsam/ ga ḍu ba'i chu gtsang gi me long gi gdan la bshal chus bkrus la/ de nas dri'i bum pa thogs te/ dpon slob rnams kyis dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzad/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ghan+dha snā na pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ sngags kyi ring la me long gi ldar la sku khrus gsol/ dri'i bum pa bzhag la/ de dag sku la sogs sngags bcas gong bzhin gyis sku phyi'o/ /cho ga sogs kyi chings khrus bum brgyad ka la 'dis rigs 'gre'o/ /'on kyang rgyal ba'i sku la sogs mi dgos/ de nas ka ya bi shwa dha na'i sngags gsum dang bstun rdzas gsum gyis byug chu gtsang gis bkru/ de nas mngar gsum gyi bum pa thogs la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya 'o/ /sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las/ gan+dha snā na'i gnas su/ tri ma dhū snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing / de dag sogs kyis sku phyi'o/ /yang sngags dang bstun te rdzas gsum gyis byugs nas chu gtsang gis bkrus la/ zho'i bum pa thogs la/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /gtong ba dri yis legs bgos chus/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /tri ma dhu snā na'i gnas su ma la snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing /

de dag sogs kyis sku phyis/ yang sngags dang bstun te rdzas gsum gyis byugs nas chu gtsang gis bkrus la/ 'bras bu'i bum pa thogs te/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu/ /khrims 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /tshul khrims dri yis legs bgos chus/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /ma la snā na'i gnas su pha la snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing / de dag sogs kyis sku phyi'o/ /yang sngags dang bstun te rdzas gsum gyis byug cing / chu gtsang gis bkrus la/ 'bru'i bum pa thogs te/ 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /bzod pa dri yis legs bgos chus/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /pha la snā na'i gnas su bru hi snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing / de dag sogs kyis sku phyis/ yang sngags dang bstun te rdzas gsum gyis byug cing / chu gtsang gis bkrus la/ 'bras yos kyi bum pa thogs te/ 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu/ /le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /brtson 'grus dri yis legs bgos chus/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /bru hi snā na'i gnas su/ lardza snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing / de dag sogs kyis sku phyis/ yang sngags dang bstun te rdzas gsum gyis byug cing chu gtsang gis bkrus la/ sman gyi bum pa thogs te/ 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu/ /rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /bsam gtan dri yis legs bgos chus/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /lardza snā na'i gnas su/ oṃ ṣa dhi snā na sogs kyis bkru zhing / de dag sogs kyis sku phyis/ yang sngags dang bstun te rdzas gsum gyis byug cing / chu gtsang gis bkrus la/ rin po che'i bum pa thogs la/ 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu/ /shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /shes rab dri yis legs bgos chus/ /khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi snā na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/

sogs kyis bkru zhing / de dag sogs kyis sku phyis/ de nas dri yi bum pa thogs te/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas/ /bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ /gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing / /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas/ /dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad pa/ /rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i/ /khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'/ /dri ma rnam drug dag pa yis/ /yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du/ /dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi 'o/ /zhes brjod cing tshigs bcad re'i mjug tu bum chu blug de nas khrus long bzhag la/ bum pa lag pa g.yon pas bzung / g.yas pa'i ku sha'i rtsa bas tshigs bcad re re dang bstun/ rten rnams la bum chu 'thor tshul bya/ dpon slob rnams kyis dril bsil gdangs dang bcas/ tshigs bcad re'i mjug tu rten la nas gtor zhing / gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /rnam bcom dri ma med mdzad pa/ /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing / /chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ /khyed la dge legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gang la bde ba mnga' mdzad des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /skyobs pa gang zhig byams pa yis/ /thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing / /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/ /khyed la dge legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur/ /gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la/ /gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa/ /phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor zhing /

/don 'grub tshogs kyang 'grub pa des/ /khyed la dge legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig skyes pa'i sa rnams ni/ /nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yo zhing / /sems can thams cad rab dga' des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /byang chub snying por gshegs pa na/ /sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing / /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing / /thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/ /khyed la dge legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed/ /thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing / /tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ /khyed la dge legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang / /'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni/ /khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang / /lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis/ /khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa/ /don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam du bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la'ang bde legs shing / /khyed cag kun tu bde legs gyur/ khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /ces brjod cing nyin mo bde legs dang bstun sna tshogs rol mo mdzad/ de nas mchod g.yog pas dri'i bum pa de nyid g.yas dang / khrus long g.yon du khyer la/ rten gsar rnying thams cad la me long bstan zhing / gong bzhin khrus byas/ dpon slob rnams kyis dril gsil gdangs dang bcas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /sogs gong bzhin brjod cing bkru/ rol mo bya/ de dag sku la sogs sngags dang bcas pas sku phyis/

de nas bum pa khrus long / sku phyis/ rdor dril sogs bzhag go /khrus bum gcig las med na rten gsar pa bkru ba man thams cad de nyid kyis bya ba yin no/ /de nas ring bsrel bzhugs pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel lam/ rigs sngags chen mo dang / rten 'brel snying po dang / so so thar pa rnams/ gur gum dang gi ham̐ bsres pas bris pa/ sku gzugs rnams kyi dbu'i rgyab phyogs su bug pa yod na bzhugs/ bug pa med pa'am/ mchod rten sku gzugs sngar bzhugs zin na ring bsrel mi dgos la/ gzungs dang so so thar pa bris pa dbu'i bre la btags/ bris sku la sogs pa'i dbu'i rgyab tu bri bar gsungs kyang / ding sang phyag len la dpon slob thams cad bsgrigs 'don mdzad de/ oṃ sarba bi d+ya swāhā/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa he dun+te ṣānya ta tha ga to h+ya ba dad/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī mahā shra ma ṇaḥ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du yang sdom pa legs/ /zhes lan gcig brjod pa'o/ /de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpon slob rnams snam sbyar la sogs pa gyon nas langs te/ lag tu me tog dang rol mo thogs nas/ de'i yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/

/zhes brjod cing rol mo dang me tog gi char dbab/ spos kyis bdug 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags brjod/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang yang dag ldan pa stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum dang / thugs rje chen po la sogs pa mdor na slob pa dang / mi slob pa'i sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos rnams dang yang dag par ldan pa/ de'i skyon gyi nyes pa thams cad dang bral zhing / bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /rol mo sogs gong bzhin/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi bla na med pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa'i phung po lnga dang yang dag par ldan pa dang / cho 'phrul gsum dang / ting nge 'dzin gsum dang / bslab pa gsum dang / tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang yang dag par ldan pas/ de'i yang dag pa phyin ci ma log pa'i ye shes dang / shes bya'i yul thams cad la mnga' brnyes pas nyon mongs pa ma lus pa la sogs pa rnams spangs pa dang / bdud bzhi las rab tu rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /rol mo sogs gong bzhin/ gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par bsags pa dang / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis yang dag par brgyan pa dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus yang dag par mdzes pa dang / skyes bu chen po'i sku lta bas chog mi shes pa dang / mthong na mi mthun pa med pa ste/ de'i gzugs kyi sku'i 'byor pa mthar thug pas/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /rol mo sogs gong bzhin dang /

oṃ na mo bha ga wa ste shākya mu na ye ta thā ga ta ya a ra ha te samyak+sam̐ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni mahā mu na ye swāhā/ zhes dang / rab gnas kyi lha gang yin pa ngo shes pa rnams kyi sngags dang / rang gi yi dam gyi lha'i sngags kyang cung zad cig bzla'o/ /rjes dran bzhi po 'di lan gsum mdzad de/ sems bskyed kyi tshig thams cad lan gsum re 'don pa gzhung du ma nas 'byung ba la/ 'di sems bskyed kyi tshig tu slob dpon zhi ba snying pos bshad ces rje rdo rje 'chang gi rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtshor gsungs so/ /rjes dran bzhi po 'di'i mjug gi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dag gis rab tu gnas pa bgyi'o/ /zhes pa 'di la rab gnas kyi dpe 'ga' zhig las/ 'di bdag gis zhes 'byung yang / 'di rnams kyi'am/ 'di dag gi zhes mang tshig brjod na legs pa rab gnas kyi rnam bshad du ma las 'byung ba yin te/ de yang 'di dag brjod pa'i skabs kyi dmigs pa ni/ rten gyi steng gi nam mkha' la phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nas 'od zer gyi dra ba dpag tu med pa 'phros te 'od zer gyi dra bas khyab par byas pa'i steng du/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsgoms nas/ de rnams kyis rten de la byin gyis rlob cing rab tu gnas pa byas par bsgom zhing / de bzhin du bdag gis kyang rab tu gnas pa byas par bsgom pa yin la/ rab gnas kyi cho ga rnam dag cig byung na/ de ltar byin gyis rlobs pa rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin te/ sngon chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas dpal ldan sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying ma'i 'jam dbyangs la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ de dus kyi thugs dam pa bzang por byed pa bla ma gsal chen par grags pas de ltar du mthong ba'i lo rgyus dang / chos rje bla ma dam pas/ bo dong gi lha khang gsar pa la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ bla ma nyid kyis de lta bu'i bkod pa ngo mtshar can gzigs pa dang /

khro phu lo tsā bas byams chen la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe yang / khong rang gi gzigs snang la de ltar shar ba'i lo rgyus bzhin no/ /zhes rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun dri ma med pa/ chos rje shes rab rgya mtsho dang dpal gyi ba sogs kyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas don gsal gyi bshad pa'i zin bris mig thur gsal byed sgron me sogs rab gnas kyi rnam bshad mang po las 'byung zhing / de bzhin du sngags 'chang chen po sku dngos kyi phyag dpe bris ma zhig la yang 'di'i skabs su bris bsub mdzad de/ 'di dag gis zhes par bsgyur ba gnang 'dug pas/ rjes 'jug blo ldan rnams kyis dgongs par mdzad 'tshal lo/ /de nas stan la tsog pur 'dug lag pa'i mthil gnyis bsdams pa'i bar du nas cung zad bzung la/ byams pa dang snying rje kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems cung zad bsgom ste/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /ngo mtshar chen po grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyi ba de'i mthus/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi dbugs dbyung ngo / /'khor ba'i gcong rong chen po las bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /phas kyi rgol ba bdud dang log 'dren thams cad pham par bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil bar bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi skye ba'i ljon shing rtsad nas gcod do/ /'chi bdag gi nyi ma phye mar brlag go /ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bgyi'o/ /ma dad pa dang phyir rgol ba dag dang / lta ba phyin ci log pa yang dag pa'i lta ba la zungs shig dad pas bsgyur ro/ /las kyi chu bo bzlog par bgyi'o/

/srid pa'i rgya mtsho skem par bgyi'o/ /chos kyi sgron me sbar bar bgyi'o/ /byang chub kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /bzod pa dang nges pa la gzud do/ /bsam gtan gyi bde ba la brtser stsal to/ /'dod chags kyi me phung gzhil bar bgyi'o/ /zhe sdang gi mtshon rtse rnon po gzhom par bgyi'o/ /bden pa la gzud do/ /phrag dog gi 'tshub ma zhi bar bgyi'o/ /ser sna'i mdud pa dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o/ /'jigs pa ma mchis pa dang / bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug cing gnas par bgyi'o/ /de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub kyi mchog stsol zhing gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dpon slob thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu brjod cing lag na yod pa'i nas rnams gtor/ snam sbyar sogs bzhag nas gral la 'dug go /de nas rten bskyed pa ni/ rten rnams/ a mri tas bsangs/ shū n+ya tas rten rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ chos skyong nor lha'i sku thams cad pad+ma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje 'chang kye rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud ka zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis nag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad na rdo rje dang / g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la/ g.yon gnyis bskums pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/

sgeg pa dpa' ba sogs/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ dkyil 'khor rnams pam̐ las pad+ma dang / ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ 'khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi rol tu dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa dang / srung 'khor dur khrod med pa rnams 'od zer 'phreng ba sogs dkyil 'khor so so'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du so so'i lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gdan gyi steng du gtso 'khor thams cad oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ chos pu ti dang gzungs dang yig 'bru rnams rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du dz+riṃ las pad+ma dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med kye rdo rje sku mdog dmar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad na pad+ma/ g.yon brgyad na des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/

yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ tsha tsha sogs thugs mchod rten gyi rigs rnams pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyi mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad na 'khor lo dang / g.yon brgyad na des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i chos sku'i mchod rten tshad dang mtshan nyid rgyan la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan lnga'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje sogs dang / shar du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ lhor aṃ las rin po che aṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan kyai rdo rje sku mdog ser po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rin po che/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ nub tu dz+riṃ las pad+ma dz+riṃ gi mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od dpag med kyai rdo rje sku mdog dmar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad pad+ma/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

byang du kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ don yod grub pa kyai rdo rje sku mdog ljang khu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad ral gri g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rigs lnga thams cad kyang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ gur zhal sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i chos skyong gi sku rnams hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ gtsug lag khang 'di nyid pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad na 'khor lo dang / g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i gtsug lag khang tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan lnga'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje sogs dang / shar du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ sogs mchod rten skabs sgra ji bzhin las cung zad mi 'dra ba ni/ rigs lnga thams cad kyang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i byang shar du gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad/

zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa sogs chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang / shar lhor rnam thos sras dzam+bha la nor rgyun ma dmar po skor gsum dbyug gu ma mched gsum sogs nor lha'i tshogs rnams gsal bar bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ gtsug lag khang gi rten bskyed la gzhan mchod rten bzhin las mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnam snang zhu ba las gtsug lag khang du gyur pa'i shar du chos skyong gi lha tshogs dang / shar lhor nor lha'i tshogs bskyed dgos pa ni/ gtsug lag khang der 'du ba'i dge 'dun gyi sde la sogs pa 'phel ba dang / de rnams la chos mthun gyi longs spyod che zhing / dus kun tu bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa yod ces chos rje shes rab rgya mtsho ba sogs kyis mdzad pa'i rje rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsung rgyun zin bris rnams las 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa lags/ de ltar bshad pa'i rten bskyed 'di rnams rten gsar pa ji ltar yod pa dang bstun pa'i 'dor len bya dgos pas/ blo gsal rnams kyis slob dpon blun po'i ngag rjes mi 'brang bar/ rang rang gi rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyis zhib tu dpyad dgos so/ /lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ zhes brjod cing bsams la byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas ye shes pa spyan drang zhing dgug gzhug bya ba la gsum/ spyan drang ba dngos/ bgegs bskrad cing mchod pa/ dgug gzhug bya ba'o/ /dang po ni dpon slob rnams kyis rdo dril dang / slob dpon gyis spos gzung la/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rang 'dra'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya/

de nas gdangs dang bcas pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ yang dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi zad nus par ldan/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi dag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /oṃ bha ga wān mahā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya hoḥs ma ya satwam̐/ zhes brjod la spyan drangs nas spos bzhag gnyis pa bgegs bskrad cing mchod pa ni/ ngag tu/ ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig ces brjod la/ las thams cad pa'i sngags/ a mṛ ta bzlas/ yungs dkar gyis brabs/ gu gul gyis bdug cing dril gsil rol mo drag tu bya/ de nas mchod pa ni/

bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod yon dang / ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs rje'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwam̐/ zhes pas gdan phul/ lha la sogs pa'i dri yi rdzas/ /phyogs rnams kun na gang yod pa/ /tshim byed yid 'ong ldan pa 'di/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ zhing 'di'am rgya chen zhing gzhan na/ /lha rdzas me tog yid 'ong ba/ /chu dang thang skyes yid 'byung 'di/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu kun nas bdug spos 'di/ /lha rdzas spos kyi shing la sogs/ /dri zhim yid 'ong gang yod pa/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ 'jig rten 'di 'am phyogs rnams na/ /lha dang mi la sogs pa'i zas/ /yon tan kun ldan gang yin de/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu yi/ /rin chen mar me la sogs pa/ /snang ba'i khyad par gang yod de/ /thub dbang la ni 'bul bar bgyi/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don ston cing / /shes rab mchog gi rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra/ /bdud kyi 'khor lo gzhom phyir dbul bar bgyi/

/don gyi dbyings la mnga' brnyes 'di bzhes shig /oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing sna tshogs rol mo bya/ zhes pa'i mchod pa 'di/ rje btsun rin po ches mchod pa rnam pa lnga go rim bzhin yod kyang / ding sang bla ma rnams kun rig bzhin 'don bya bde ba la dgongs nas gong bzhin mdzad pas de ltar du bkod pa la/ bla med rdo rje theg pa ste rol mo'i tshigs bcad 'di don gsal bzhin/ gsum pa dgug gzhug bya ba la gnyis kyi dang po rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dgug pa ni/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes pa dam tshig pa dang nye bar spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes pas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bzhugs/ oṃ badz+ra bait+ta lī ban+dha bam̐/ zhes ro gcig tu 'dres/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes pas dam tshig pa rnams ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes yang yang brjod cing bstim mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ slar yang rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdun gyi nam mkha' gang ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdus pa'i phyag rgya bya/ de nas slob dpon gyis spos dang / gzhan dpon slob tshang mas dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /dga' ldan du ni gnas pa nas/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu/ /'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / /sbyin pa'i bdag po'i don slad du/ /bdag gi 'byor ba nyid kyis ni/ /ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa rnams/ /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bar dgongs su gsol/ /kun gyis 'di la byin brlabs shing / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/

/zhes lan gsum brjod la/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī sogs dang / dzaḥhūm̐ sogs yang yang brjod cing / dmigs pa ni/ gong du spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams na bun 'thibs pa ltar 'od zer dpag tu med pa dang bcas thib thib byon nas rten rnams la char chen po phab pa ltar sib sib thim par bsam/ de nas rgyas gdab pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par ā las pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum gyi gsol ba gdab/ de nas rten dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa la las bum gyi chu ku shas gtor zhing / oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ rten dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma zhes pa nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma zhes pa'i bar brjod/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa kye rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ gau rī a kar+ṣa ya/ phyag rgya dang bcas pa dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gcig gis rten dang dbang rdzas la bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis/ /khyed kyis 'di la dbang bskur stsol/ /de nas slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa btegs nas/ rten rnams la nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang slob dpon gyi dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar brjod cing bum chu ting la sogs pa'i snod du blug de nyid mchod g.yog pas rten gsar pa'i drung du bzhag de nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang / bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying kha yan chad gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang / mchog tu bde ba chen po bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar gyi mchod pa lngas mchod/

rten dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan la las bum gyi chu gtor/ swa bhā wa brjod/ rten dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du aṃ las rin po che aṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan kye rdo rje sku mdog ser po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rin po che/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu/ sogs brjod/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par gong ltar spyan drangs te so so la bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ badz+ri bha wa sogs dang / rnam rgyal bum chu ku shas dbang rdzas la gtor ba 'di man thams cad 'dra bar byas te/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yis/ /khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa a bh-i ṣiñca mi badz+ra ra ga ta badz+ra sha li hoḥzhes brjod cing dbu brgyan rten rnams la 'bul tshul byas la mchod g.yog pa la gtad de/ rten gsar pa'i drung du bzhag 'di man la rnam rgyal bum chu ku shas rten rnams la 'thor tshul dang / oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bh-i ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/

sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ 'di tsam gyis chog puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ rten dang dbang rdzas rdo rje la las bum gyi chu dang / swa bhā wa sogs/ rten dang dbang rdzas mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du dz+riṃ las pad+ma dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad pad+ma/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu sogs brjod cing / thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'od dpag med kye rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs la sogs so sor bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ badz+rī bhā wa sogs kyis/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas 'od du zhu ste rdo rjer gyur pa/ sogs gong bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje thogs la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /sogs sh+lau gcig dang / oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rten rnams la rdo rje 'bul tshul byas la/ mchod g.yog pa la gtad de rten gsar pa'i drung du bzhag rnam rgyal bum chu gtor zhing / badz+ri bhā wa sogs kyis gong bzhin dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ rten dang dbang rdzas dril bu la las bum gyi chu gtor zhing / swa bhā wa sogs/ rten dang dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/

gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa kyai rdo rje ljang khu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad ral gri/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu sogs brjod/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad don yod grub pa kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs la so sor bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ badz+ri bhā wa sogs kyis dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas 'od du zhu ste dril bur gyur/ sogs gong bzhin brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyi dril bu thogs la/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod cing dril bu gsil la rten rnams la 'bul tshul byas/ mchod g.yog pa la gtad de/ rten gsar pa'i drung du bzhag rnam rgyal bum chu gtor zhing / badz+rī bhā wa sogs kyi gong bzhin/ dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ rten rnams la las bum gyi chu dang / swa bhā wa sogs/ rten rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad 'khor lo/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu sogs brjod/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/

gau rī a kar+ṣas rten rnams la bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis rang gi rdo dril gnyis lag pa g.yas pas phyogs gcig dkrol/ oṃ badz+ra satwa satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing rten thams cad la gsang mtshan btags par bsam la/ rdo dril mdun du bzhag rnam rgyal bum chu gtor zhing / badz+ri bhā wa sogs gong bzhin dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swā bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ rten rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rten rnams rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu sogs brjod/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin pa gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs te bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ badz+ri bhā wa sogs kyis/ dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi mdun gyi rdo rje blang la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pa brjod cing rdo rje gsor la rten rnams kyi phyag g.yas par phul ba'i mos pa bya ba ste slob ma'i dbang ngo / /slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/

/slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes brjod cing dbang bskur bar bsam/ gsang dbang ni/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gtso bos byang chub kyi sems/ rten gyi ljags thog tu bzhag par bsam ste/ slob dpon gyis nang mchod nas thur mas bdud rtsi blang la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ a hoḥmahā su kha/ zhes brjod cing rten la phul bar bsam la/ ting la sogs par blugs te mchod g.yog pas rten gsar pa'i drung du bzhag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi rig ma sprul te/ rten la phul bar bsam la/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ /zhes brjod/ dbang bzhi pa ni/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /zhes brjod cing dbang don rnams thugs rgyud la 'khrungs par bsam mo/ /de ltar na dbang bzhi bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rten thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' re res dbu brgyan/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas mchod bstod bya ba ni/ mchod stegs kyi mar me rnams sbar/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ nī rī hūm̐ kham̐ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi te hūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ sarba bī sho dha ni swāhā/

oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kha ram̐ mahā ar+gham̐ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ dhu pe/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+da'i bar gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ dku g.yon par khu tshur gnyis steng 'og tu kha sbyar te/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ bha ga wān mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nī rī hūm̐ kham̐ swāhā/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pa brjod cing / mthar se gol gtogs nas shap+da'i mthar rol chen rgyun dkrol/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs dbang chu mdzes rgyan bzhin gdangs dang bcas pa dang / de nas dril bsil dang bcas pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs de nyid lnga pa dang / hūm̐ snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la/ /gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa/ /me long ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /bdud 'dul chen po phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la/ /rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /mchog sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan la/ /'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi chu/ /kun rtog ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la/ /phrag dog rdo rje skyod pa'i rlung / /bya sgrub ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /skyabs sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la'o/ /zhes dang / 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas/ /thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/

/sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ /sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang / /chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa/ /'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sems can bkren pa chos kyis phongs gyur pa/ /ma rig 'thib po'i nang du song ba rnams/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa/ /ye shes sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la/ /thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur bzhag nas/ /zhi ba rin chen mchog gling skyel mdzad pa/ /kun gyi ded dpon khyod la kun nas 'dud/ /sems can las kyi chu bor gru nub rnams/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing / /'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa/ /gsung gi mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /sh+lau ka gcig sogs gdangs dang bcas pas bstod la/ de nas spyan dbye ba ni/ gser drug rnams las mi chung ba'i thur mas/ dngul gyi kong bur bzhag pa'i mar dang sbrang rtsi blang ba'am/ dkyil 'khor gyi rdul phra mo zhig blang la spyan gyi thad kar byug ces gsungs kyang / phyag len de dag mos pa tsam ma gtogs de dag dngos su mi mdzad/ gser gyi mig thur ma 'byor na thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du rdo rje bzung la/ spyan gyi thad kar byug tshul bya zhing / kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang / /gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi shwa dhā ni swāhā/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing / sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod/ de nas brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba gdab pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lngas mchod cing /

snang stong rdo rje sogs dang 'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs kyis bstod/ de nas dpon slob thams cad bzhengs te mgrin gcig tu/ ye dharmā lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog bzung la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di dag la sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du sems can thams cad kyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pas gtso byas/ sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod cing sna tshogs rol mo dang / rten la me tog gi char dbab/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ yang yang brjod/ rten 'brel snying po bzla 'o/ /de ltar lan gsum du byas la/ de nas zhal bsgyur ba ni/ bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs chos skyong nor lha sogs/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa' kyai rdo rjer bskyed pa rnams 'od du zhu/ bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs chos skyong nor lha la sogs pa so so'i sku'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ gur zhal sogs mi bskyed pa kyai rdo rjer bskyed pa rnams 'od du zhu/ chos srung de dang de'i sku'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ chos pu ti la sogs yig 'bru'i tshogs 'od dpag med kye rdo rjer bskyed pa rnams 'od du zhu/ lung rtogs kyi bdag nyid chos dkon mchog dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge a l̥ ka l̥'i rnam pa glegs bam sogs kyi gzugs ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ ces brjod/

gzhan zhal bsgyur mi dgos pa rnams la/ gang yang brjod mi dgos la/ zhal bsgyur 'di yang gong gi rten bskyed dang bstun pa'i 'dor len bya dgos pas hol gcod spangs te rtogs dpyod zhib par gal che'o/ /'dir ngor phyogs kyi bstan 'dzin phal cher gyis zhal bsgyur gyi rjes su brtan bzhugs bya ba kho na bshad kyang / sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin mtshungs med mkhas pa'i mchog smra ba'i seng ges rab gnas dge legs rgya mtshor/ 'di'i skabs su ngor lugs spyi dang mthun par bshad nas/ 'di ni phyag len ltar bris pa yin la/ rab gnas don gsal gyi dpe kun las/ thog mar brtan bzhugs byas nas/ de nas zhal bsgyur ba 'byung ste/ brtan bzhugs 'di rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi yin pas/ 'di ma tshar gyi bar du zhal bsgyur du mi rung ba la dgongs sam snyam mo/ /des na brtan bzhugs kyi dam tshig pa bskyed pa la/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa bstan par byas nas mnga' dbul gyi gong du rang rang gi rnam par bsgyur ba 'di dgongs pa yin pa 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba las ji ltar bshad pa'i rim pa bzhin 'dir yang bkod pa yin pas/ tshul 'di ni rje btsun gyi dgongs pa thun mong ma yin pa yin pa don gsal tshar gcig bklags pas kyang go ba yin no/ /de nas mnga' dbul rgyas par bya ba la bzhi las/ dang po mchod bstod rgyas pas mnga' dbul ba ni/ rten gsar pa'i mdun du mar me zhal zas la sogs pa'i mchod pa ci 'byor pa dang / mchod pa rnying pa rnams kha gsos la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/

oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yam̐/ shap+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod pa byin gyis brlab la gdangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ stong gsum 'di 'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa kun/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol/ /zhes dang / pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+gham̐ pra tits+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag tu/ /lha rdzas zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /bla ma༞ thugs rjes༞ sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las ar+gham̐ gyi gnas su pād+yam̐/ stong gsum༞ lha rdzas me tog༞ bla ma༞ thugs rjes༞ pā d+yam̐ gyi gnas su/ puṣ+paṃ/ stong gsum༞ lha rdzas bdug spos༞ bla ma༞ thugs rjes༞ puṣ+paṃ gyi gnas su/ dhū paṃ/ stong gsum༞ lha rdzas snang gsal༞ bla ma༞ thugs rjes༞ dhū paṃ gyi gnas su/ dī paṃ/ stong gsum༞ lha rdzas dri mchog༞ bla ma༞ thugs rjes༞ dī paṃ gyi gnas su/ gan+dhaṃ/ stong gsum༞ lha rdzas zhal zas༞ bla ma༞ thugs rjes༞ gan+dhaṃ gyi gnas su/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ stong gsum༞ lha rdzas rol mo༞ bla ma༞ thugs rjes༞ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shap+da pra tīts+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pa rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbul/ dharmā ra ṇi sogs brjod cing sna tshogs rol mo rgya cher bya/ de nas oṃ las rin chen sna bdun sprul te/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a brta ya/ a brta ya hoḥ zhes brjod cing gdangs dang bcas pas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di 'bul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra rat+na pū dzi ti hūm̐/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/

/bkren zhing phongs pa rgyun bcad de/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /sngags gong 'dra ba la tsakra'i gnas su/ ma ṇi/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /ma ṇa'i gnas su wasti/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing / /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /wasti'i gnas su mahā ta/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas/ /bla med theg pa rab zhon te/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /mahā ta'i gnas su hasti/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar shog /hasta'i gnas su/ tu raṃ ga dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /snyems bral mchog ni thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khaḍ+ga rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbul/ de nas 'dod yon lnga gdangs dang bcas pas/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun nas gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos rab gnas lha la bdag 'bul gyis/ /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ru pa ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun tu zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las ru pa'i gnas su shap+da dang / rol chen bya/ phyogs dus kun tu tsan dan sbrul snying dang / /a kar nags sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ shap+ta'i gnas su gan+dhe/ phyogs dus kun nas ro dang bcud ldan pas/ /lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞

gan+dha'i gnas su rā sa/ phyogs dus kun nas 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos༞ bzhes shig༞ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta spar+ṣe ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi ti hūm̐/ zhes dang / gos zung phul te/ de rnams la phyag dang bcas pas dbul/ de nas dril bsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku/ /mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan/ /bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /'gag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan/ /mu stegs log lta 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra/ /bde gsal mi rtog ngang tshul can/ /rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa'i/ /bla ma'i thugs la༞ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang bla ma ched du gtad pa'i sku yod cing shes na de'i sku bstod sogs skabs thob dang sbyar nas byed/ gzhan yi dam sogs lha so so'i sgo nas bstod shes shing byed par spro na'ang bya/ de tsam mi shes na/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / chos pu ti sogs la/ dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing / /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / mchod rten la/ sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /sna tshogs rin chen khams las grub pa yi/ /sprul pa'i mchod rten sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes/ /chos sku'i rang bzhin can la phyag 'tshal lo/

/steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang / /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang / /sku bcas sku ni med pa yi/ /mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / thams cad kyis thun mong du/ snang stong rdo rje dang / 'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs gong bzhin dang / mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam nyid dam pa'i chos mchog can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ /dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bsgrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas dpag med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ /rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung / /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don sgrub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / /tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yis/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang / /khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog rnams stsol mdzad pa'i/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yongs mi 'gyur/ /e ma ho shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ /khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub stsol mdzad pa/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pas/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag yon tan rgya chen te/ /lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang / /sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstod do/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu nye bar mkho bas mnga' dbul la gnyis kyi/ dang po rten thams cad la spyir mnga' dbul ba'i sdom ni/ dkyil 'khor khrus dang na bzas brgyan/

/rnam lnga rin chen bdun dang bcud/ /gdugs sogs dang ni spyi pa'i sogs/ /zhes pa ltar brgyad las/ dang po dkyil 'khor ni/ gling bzhi gling phran brgyad ri rab dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bris pa ste/ rten rnams la dngos su phul bar bsams la 'bul ba'i tshul bya zhing / slob dpon gyis rgyab yig bklags la gdangs dang bcas pas/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi legs par brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra su re khe āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing mchod g.yog pa la gtad/ mnga' dbul stegs rin po che'i snod 'bru sogs kyis bkang ba'i mthar rim pa bzhin bkod pa mdzes par gcal du bkram par bya'o/ /gnyis pa khrus ni/ khrus bum bris pa dngos su phul bar bsams la 'bul ba'i tshul bya zhing / stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byugs par bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gong bzhin gtad/ gsum pa na bza' ni/ sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / byang sems khyim pa'i cha lugs can dang / mchod rten dang / glegs bam rnams la dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde/ /srab 'jam yang mdzes lha las byung ba yi/ /na bza' mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul/ /bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra wasatra s+ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku dang / byang chub sems dpa'/ nyan thos sogs rten rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can rnams la ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / dri med mtshan la sgrib gsal mi mnga' yang /

/dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ bzhi pa rgyan ni/ rin po che'i prog zhu la sogs pa rgyan mang po bris pa phul bar bsam zhing / rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir/ /rgyan gzhan dag ni brgyan par mi 'tshal yang / /rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra a laṃ kā ra wa su kha ṇi āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ lnga pa 'dod yon lnga'i gzugs bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / rgyal ba zag med 'byor la mnga' bsgyur yang / /'gro ba'i don du 'dod yon rnam lnga yis/ /mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis/ /bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra man+ta bha tra pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ drug pa rin chen bdun gyi rgyal srid sna bdun bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la/ /bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis/ /'gro ba mi zad gter la longs spyod shog /oṃ badz+ra sap+da rat+na pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ bdun pa bcud ni rin po che'i snod lngar/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ rin po che lnga/ snying po lnga blugs pa'i gzugs bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyi lham mer bzhugs/ /bsod nams ye shes sku lnga brnyes pa la/ /lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa 'bul/ /'gro bas bde gshegs snying po thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra pañca pañca bi ma la pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ brgyad pa gdugs sogs ni/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / bla bre dang /

rol mo la sogs pa'i gzugs bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / brtse ba'i khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan dang / /ting 'dzin bla bre spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba/ /mchog rkyen 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag 'bul/ /skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra mahā pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad pa rnams ni rten spyi la 'bul ba'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag rten so so la 'bul ba'i sdom ni/ spu gri 'breg gcod so mang dang / /smang gzer tshems shing sna ba bzhar ro/ /zhes pa ltar drug las/ dang po ni rab tu byung ba'i cha lags can rnams la gser gyi spu gri bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / dbu skra dang zhal spu 'breg pa'i tshul byas la/ rgyal ba'i dbu skra mthon mthing skyon bral yang / /gzhan don sgrub phyir khyim pa'i rtags spang phyir/ /dad pas gser gyi 'breg gcod phul ba yis/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ka tsa mu le āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ gnyis pa 'breg bcad ni/ gser gyi 'breg bcad bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam la/ sen mo 'breg pa'i tshul bya zhing / zangs mdog ltar mdzes yid 'ong skyon bral yang / /bdag cag dad pas phyag dang zhabs rnams kyi/ /sen mo'i 'breg bcad phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang po thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra nā gats+tsha de dzi na āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ gsum pa so mang ni rten sangs rgyas longs sku'i cha lugs can rnams dang / byang sems khyim pa'i tshul can rnams la gser gyi so mang bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam la/ dbu skra shad pa'i tshul bya zhing / dbu skra rin chen lcang lo ma dkrugs shing / /mdzes shing lta bas mi ngom skyon bral yang / /bdag blo sbyang phyir rkyen dang 'tshams pa 'di/ /phul bas 'gro kun dug gsum bral bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ba la sho dha ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/

zhes brjod cing gtad/ bzhi pa smang gzer ni/ gser gyi smra 'jab bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam la/ shangs dang zhal spu 'thog pa'i tshul bya zhing / dri 'dzin rnam dag tshul khrims las 'khrungs pa/ /dge ba sgrub phyir skyon las nges grol yang / /mos pas 'dzin spyad dam pa phul ba yis/ /'gro bas bla med byang chub thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ro ma dha ra āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ lnga pa tshems shing gser dngul las byas pa'i tshems shing bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam la/ tshems kyi srub rnams 'bru tshul bya zhing / dkar la thags bzang bzhi bcu tshang ba'i tshems/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos la mnga' bsgyur yang / /bdag cag dad pas tshems shing dbul lags kyis/ /'gro bas sangs rgyas gsung dbyangs thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra dan+ta sho dha ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ drug pa snab bzhar ni/ snyan 'dru ba'i thur ma bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam la/ snyan 'dru ba'i tshul bya zhing / snyan bsring mi mnga' kun tu gsal bar ldan/ /thub pa'i sgra 'dzin ngo bo sangs na yang / /dag byed 'di ni bdag gis 'bul lags kyis/ /skye bos rtag tu dam chos thos par shog /oṃ badz+ra karna sho dha ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ sprul sku rnams la so mang dang / longs sku rnams la spu gri mi 'bul ba tsam mo/ /mchod rten la bye brag tu mnga' dbul gyi sdom ni/ srog shing 'khor lo cod pan 'phan/ /rgyan mtshan gdugs dang phreng ba dang / /zhes pa ltar brgyad las/ dang po srog shing ni srog shing bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam shing / oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swāhā/ sems can thams cad shes pa bcu dang ldan par gyur cig bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos ring du mi nub cing gnas par gyur cig sems can thams cad lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas kun tu bzang po'i smon lam la 'jug par gyur cig zhes brjod cing gtad/

gnyis pa 'khor lo ni/ gdugs rim pa bcu gsum char khebs tog dang bcas pa bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ pra ma dha nā ya swāhā/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum thob par gyur cig rnam par thar pa brgyad thob par gyur cig ye shes lnga dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod cing gtad/ gsum pa cod pan ni/ dar gyi cod pan bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ pa taṃ ka laṃ pa ya swāhā/ sems can thams cad dus thams cad du dar gyi cod pan dang lhab lhub la sogs pas mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur gyi rnam pa mang pos de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang / de dag gi mchod rten dang / sku gzugs dang / gsung rab la sogs pa dag la mchod pa byed par gyur cig ces brjod cing gtad/ bzhi pa 'phan ni/ dar 'phan sna tshogs bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ pa taṃ ke swāhā/ sems can thams cad chos kyi grags pa'i snyan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par gyur cig ces brjod cing gtad/ lnga pa rgyal mtshan ni/ chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ kum+bhi ra dh+wa dzā ya swāhā/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba mi 'dzin mi gtong bas bdud bzhi las rgyal zhing chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig ces brjod cing gtad/ drug pa gdugs ni/ gdugs bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ bh+ra ma ṇa ya swāhā/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i skyabs dang ldan zhing chos kyi rgyal po chen po gyur cig ces brjod cing gtad/ bdun pa phreng ba ni/ me tog sna tshogs bris pa'i phreng ba ni dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / rat+na mā la traṃ/ na ma satrai ya dhi/ a nu ga ta/ pra tiṣ+ṭha ta puṣ+pe ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+sam̐ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ sems can thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan te/
