sku lta bas chog mi shes pa thob par gyur cig ces brjod cing gtad/ brgyad pa gdan ni/ rin po che la sogs pa'i 'og gi tshig rigs dang mthun pa bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / oṃ pu ṇ+ya dha ri dza ye swāhā/ sems can thams cad kyis gdan gyi khyad par stobs bcu dang ldan pa glang po che'i gdan dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan pa seng ge'i gdan dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang ldan pa rta'i gdan dang / dbang bcu dang ldan pa rma bya'i gdan dang / thams cad du thogs pa med pa stobs kyi shugs dang ldan pa nam mkha' lding gi gdan dang / 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du bskong ba nor bu rin po che'i gdan dang / chags pa'i skyon thams cad spang ba pad+ma'i gdan dang / rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba nyi zla'i gdan thob par gyur cig ces brjod cing gtad/ glegs bam la sogs pa gsung rab bye brag tu mnga' dbul ba'i sdom ni/ bzhugs khri dang ni na bza' dang / /glegs shing dang ni glegs thag go /zhes pa ltar bzhi las/ dang po bzhugs khri ni/ chos kyi khri seng ges btegs pa dang dar zab bkab pa bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / rin chen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri/ /yid 'ong sna tshogs gos kyis bkab pa 'di/ /spros bral gsung rab mchog la phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs par shog /oṃ badz+ra ā pa nā ya ā hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ gnyis pa na bza' ni/ rten khebs bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra yang / /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ gsum pa glegs shing ni/ glegs shing bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / zung 'jug dam chos 'dzin pa kun bral yang / /thabs dang shes rab rjes su 'brel gyur pa'i/

/nyi zla lta bu'i rten 'brel dga' bya ba/ /phul bas skye bos zung 'jug rtogs par shog /oṃ badz+ra pradz+nyā u pa ya a dā ya āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad/ bzhi pa glegs thag ni/ chos kyi pod long dang bcas bris pa dngos su phul bar bsam zhing / spros pa du ma rab tu rgyas gyur kyang / /ye shes chen po ro gcig gyur pa ltar/ /glegs bam gcig gyur yo byad phul ba yis/ /'gro bas ye shes chen po rtogs par shog /oṃ badz+ra pusta ka ban+dha āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing gtad la/ mchod g.yog pas mnga' dbul gyi stegs kyi steng du mdzes par bkod la/ gsum pa sbyin sreg gam tsa ru'i bza' bas mnga' dbul ba ni/ sbyin sreg byed na kye rdo rje'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg nas bshad pa'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bzhin so so'i phyag len ltar gtsug lag khang sogs gnas khang yangs shing du ba'i skyon mi 'byung na khyams smad la sogs pa gang 'os dang / yang gnas de nyid du mi yong na phyi rol steng la sogs pa gang 'os su bya/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i skabs su rab gnas kyi rten gyi gtso bo bla ma'i sku yin na rdo rje 'chang kye rdo rje dang / mchod rten dang lha khang yin na rnam snang kye rdo rje dang / gsung rab glegs bam yin na 'od dpag med kyai rdo rje sogs skabs thob dang bstun nas thab tu spyan drangs la/ mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i 'bras bu'i gtso byas pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul/ bdag dang yon bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba'i phyir dūr ba sogs kyis sbyin sreg bya zhing / 'o thug sgrub pa sogs byed par spro na/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po yab sras kyi yig cha bkra shis rgya mtsho dang / dge legs rgya mtsho gnyis la sogs par lta bar bya'o/ /ding sang phyag len la sbyin sreg mi mdzad pas ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon cung zad tsam yang med pas/

rje btsun rin po ches ma grub na snod bzang po'i nang du lha bshos chen po rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa bzhag la sogs gsungs pas/ ding sang phyag len la rtsa ru'i bza' ba kho na mdzad pas snod bzang po'i nang du 'brang rgyas zhos byugs shing mar gyi nyi zla nor bu sogs kyis brgyan pa la dar ser po'i rgyal mtshan/ dar kha gang tsam btsugs pa'i mthar bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / btung ba sna tshogs pa bsham pa/ de yang rab gnas kyi yo lang thams cad dkar gsum dang mngar gsum kho na la brten dgos te/ rab gnas byas pa'i phan yon 'jig rten gyi khams dang / khyad par gnas de nyid du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i bde skyid 'byung ba'i rgyu sdig pa spangs shing dge ba sgrub dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /yang sbyin bdag gi 'byor ba dang mi bstun kha med shar na/ ched du gtad nas dmigs te bsad pa ma yin pa'i sha skam smug ji ltar rigs pa dang / btung ba yang dge slong rab tu byung ba rnams la zho 'o ma/ khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams la bkras chang du dmigs te chang phor ba re tsam ma gtogs bzi bar mi 'thung / sbyin bdag gzo bo sogs la dgos pa'i sha chang / gnas khang zur ba zhig tu byed pa ma gtogs tsa ru'i bza' ba'i sar mi sgrig go /de ltar tsa ru'i bza' ba rnams ras la sogs pa'i steng du bzhag mchod g.yog pas las bum nas chu de dag la gtor/ dpon slob thams cad kyis nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yeḥsarba thā kham̐/ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum dang / re re'i mjug tu se gol gtog go /de ltar 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs nas/ rab gnas kyi rten la phul bar bsam zhing gdangs dang bcas pas/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa/ /legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun/

/'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /tshar gsum gyi rjes su/ oṃ dī bya a n+ne sa ma dhi dh+yā na pra ṇa ne swāhā/ zhes brjod bza' bca' btung ba rnams kyi phud nas/ mchod g.yog pas snod gtsang mar cung zad re bsdus la rten gsar ma'i drung du phul/ lhag ma rnams phyi rol tu phyag bde ba rnams kyis lhag chad med pa'i 'khos dang / 'brang rgyas shing ngam thur mas btub pa ma gtogs gris mi gtub bo/ /bzhi pa bkra shis dang rab gnas kyi sngags kyi mnga' dbul ba ni/ rten gyi gtso bo la gzungs thag btags pa dpon slob kun gyis bzung la/ rten la nas gtor zhing / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ oṃ hūm̐ hriḥbh+rum̐ kham̐ badz+rī bha wa tri dh+ra tiṣ+ṭha bhū kham̐ swāhā/ zhes pa nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / de nas dpon slob thams cad kyis dril bu rol mo sogs rgya cher bya zhing / sngags gong bzhin ji ltar rigs pa bzlas so/ /logs bris la sogs pa rdo rje gzung thag 'dogs mi bde ba'am ma 'byor na med kyang skyon med de/ rje btsun rin po ches de ltar ma byas kyang nyes pa med do zhes gsungs pas/ sngags bzlas shing me tog gtor ba sogs byas pas chog go /de nas dpon slob thams cad kyis dbu zhwa bzhes la dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo dbang gi rgyal po ltar/ /sogs bla ma yi dam chos srung sogs kyi bkra shis rang rang gi blo dang bstun rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa rol mo dang bcas pas me tog gi char dbab bo/ /de nas zhwa rnams phud la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyi mgor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ snang stong rdo rje sogs dang / 'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs kyis bstod/ de nas mjug gi cho ga la sdom ni/ gtor ma sbyin dang chos skyong bsgo/ /bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol/

/yon bdag bsgo zhing shis pa brjod/ /rten mchod bsod nams yongs su bsngo/ /slob dpon mchod dang dga' ston bya/ /slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod/ /rjes bsdu sbyin sreg mjug don no/ /zhes pa ltar las/ dang po gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ gong du bshams pa'i gtor ma rnams/ kye rdor bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ yi dam bde kye/ chos skyong gur zhal 'khor bcas/ dur khrod bdag po/ dkar bdud phur bsrung / mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag gi bar du gtor ma phul la/ de nas bzlas pa bshags pa sogs bya zhing / gong du bskang gtor bshams pa sogs/ skabs su babs tshe rol mo rnga brdung sogs dang bcas bskang gso rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa dang / bstod pa gang rung byas rjes/ rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis/ bsngo ba/ smon lam gyi bar sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i gtor chog chen mo sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/ de nas chos skyong bsgo ba ni/ rab tu gnas pa'i rten sogs chos skyong gang la gtad pa de la gtor ma sbyin nas bka' bsgo ba yin pas/ chos skyong bsgo ba'i gtor ma de nyid yi dam gyi gtor bsngo'i dus gtor ma thams cad byin rlabs rgyas pa grub zin yang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥzhes bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang bcas byin rlabs bsdus pa dran par byas la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs gur zhal gang ris kyi gtor chog ltar bskyed cing gtor ma phul la 'phrin las bcol/ de nas/ bdag gis rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pas rten 'di la/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis bsrung ba dang skyong bar gyis shig ces bsgo/ chos skyong nus pa bskyed pa'i phyir rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa ham̐/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje'i go bkon nas nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa bya/ de nas bdag gi bka' las mi 'da' bar bya ba'i rdo rje thogs la mgo bor bzhagapa'i tshul bya zhing dam la bzhag par bsam la/

ngag tu/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs/ /gal te dam las 'das gyur na/ /'jig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /oṃ mahā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ bdag dang yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la bsrung ba dang / bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang / rten 'di la mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces bka' bsgos shing dam la bzhag go /chos skyong bsgo ba rje btsun rin po ches nag po chen po la zhes gsungs pas sa skya pa rnams gur zhal gang ris la mdzad dgos so/ /gtor ma sbyin pa'i skabs su/ sbyin bdag gi blo dang bstun bskang gso byas nas/ sgrub khang gi steng du gtor ma 'bul dgos na/ 'di'i mtshams sam gtor ma sbyin pa'i rjes la/ dpon slob rnams bzhengs te pu tra bskul/ steng du spyi stabs kyi gtor ma phul/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma sogs so so'i phyag len bzhin grub nas 'og tu gral la 'khod pa dang / de nas bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ de nas yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang / sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs dang / rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams dang / bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyis gshegs su gsol zhing dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ rang nyid kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas/ 'gro ba thams cad kyai rdo rje'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa yin no/ /zhes brjod/ de nas yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ rang gi mdun ji ltar rigs par gdan ser po'i steng du nas cung zad bkram la/ sbyin bdag rnams bos te 'dug tu bcug la/ dpon slob rnams kyis dbu zhwa bzhes la bsgrigs 'don byas te/ khyod kyis nga la gang gsol ba'i/ /sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du/

/ji ltar gsungs pa ji bzhin du/ /de dag don ni ngas byas te/ /de rnams don ni bsgrubs zin gyis/ /ci bde bar ni mchod par byos/ /zhes dang / khyed kyis nga la gsol ba btab pa'i rab tu gnas pa de legs par tshar bar byas kyi rten 'di la khyod kyis zhag bdun gyi bar la mchod pa rgya chen po gyis shig de nas kyang ci 'byor pa'i mchod pas rgyun mi 'chad pa mchod pa gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas yon bdag la shis pa brjod pa ni/ yon bdag la las thams cad pa'i bum chu gtor zhing / a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams skad cig gis he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can re rer gsal lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ de nas mchod g.yog pas sbyin bdag rnams la me tog nas re bkye/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas sogs khro bo spyan 'dren/ bstod pa/ bden pa brdar ba'i bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ zhes pa'i bar gong drag po'i sbyang ba'i skabs bzhin byas la/ deng 'dir sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa la/ bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces brjod/ yon bdag gu gul gyis bdugs/ yungs dkar gyis brabs/ rol mo drag tu bya zhing / las thams cad pa'i sngags/ a mṛ ta dang / sum+bha ni mang du bzlas/ de 'dra lan gsum byas la bgegs bsal lo/ /de nas bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mam̐ las byung ba'i bkra shis rdzas brgyad rten dang / bdag sogs sbyin bdag gis gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang / dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur ces dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod de byin gyis brlabs la/

slob dpon gyis me long bzung nas rten la 'bul ba'i tshul bya zhing / dpon slob thams cad kyis gdangs dang bcas pas/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yis/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te/ /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba la brten nas bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di dang bdag sogs sbyin bdag gis thog drangs sems can thams cad me long gi rdzas la brten nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod cing me long mchod g.yog pa la gtad/ mchod g.yog pas dpon slob rnams dang / sbyin bdag gi lag par reg pa re byas shing bskor nas rten gsar pa'i drung du bzhag de bzhin 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis gi ham̐ 'bul tshul dang / gi ham̐ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur te/ /nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la glang po che nor skyong gis sman gi ham̐ phyag tu phul ba la brten nas zhes sogs dang / gi ham̐ gi rdzas la brten nas/ sogs gong bzhin brjod/ gi ham̐ mchod g.yog pa la gtad cing bskor ba rten gyi drung du bzhag yang slob dpon gyis zho thogs la/ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ /snying po rnam dag ye shes rnams rtogs nas/ /yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang nad kun zhi byed shog /gong 'og gong bzhin la/ zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho phyag tu phul ba sogs/ zho'i rdzas la sogs/ zho gtad cing bskor nas rten gyi drung du bzhag slob dpon gyis dūr ba thogs la/

dūr bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab sgrub nas/ /nyon mongs skye shi'i rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe ni 'phel gyur cig /rtswa 'tshong bkra shis kyis rtswa dūr ba phyag tu sogs/ dūr ba'i rdzas la sogs/ dūr ba gtad cing bskor nas rten gyi drung du bzhag slob dpon gyis bil ba thogs la/ bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu dag gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang don kun 'grub gyur cig /lha tshangs pas shing thog bil ba phyag tu sogs/ bil ba'i rdzas la sogs bil ba gtad cing bskor nas rten gyi drung du bzhag slob dpon gyis dung thogs la/ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du bdag gyur te/ /chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba phyag tu sogs/ dung dkar gyi rdzas sogs/ dung dkar gtad cing bskor la rten gyi drung du bzhag slob dpon gyis li khri thogs la/ li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma nor dbang du 'dus nas kyang / /chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pas/ /bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig /bram ze dkar rgyal gyi bus li khri phyag tu sogs/ li khri'i rdzas sogs brjod nas/ li khris rang gi dpral bar thig le bya/ mchod g.yog pas thams cad la li khri'i thig le byas nas rten gyi drung du bzhag slob dpon gyis yungs kar thogs la/ yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi byed shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes grub pa'i rdzas yungs dkar phyag tu phul ba la brten nas/

bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di dang / bdag sogs sbyin bdag gis thog drangs sems can thams cad yungs dkar gyi rdzas la brten nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod cing yungs dkar mchod g.yog pa la gtad/ dpon slob dang yon bdag la bskor rten gyi drung du bzhag de nas rab gnas kyi rten rnams mchod pa ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos byin rlabs bsdus pa byas/ 'di la yang mchod pa byin rlabs sgrigs gong bzhin dang / rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma gdangs dang bcas pa yo ga bzhin mdzad/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas sngags mchod tsam mo/ /mchod pa la tshigs bcad byed par spro na/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /sogs dang /yang na/ 'jig rten khams 'di dpag med na/ /sogs gang 'os kyi mchod la/ de nas bstod pa ni dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /sogs bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la bstod pa dang / bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /sogs dang / chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du sogs dang / dag pas 'dod chags sogs/ sna tshogs pad+ma sogs/ snang stong rdo rje sogs dang / 'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs kyis bstod/ de nas rten la phyag dang bskor ba ci nus su bya/ zhes pa rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyis gsungs pas bskor ba sogs byed par spro na/ yang sbyin bdag gi 'dod pa sogs gtsug lag khang dang / dge 'dun gyi sde sogs la rab gnas byed dgos zer na/ dpon slob thams cad kyis me tog dang rol mo gdugs rgyal mtshan la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa thogs nas/ sde la sogs pa phyi nas bskor/ rol mo bya zhing / bkra shis kyi tshig dang / rten 'brel snying po dang / su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs 'don bzhin par me tog gtor zhing bskor ba byas la/

nang du slebs nas gral la 'khod de/ de nas bsod nams bsngo ba ni/ dpon slob thams cad kyi phyag tu me tog bzung la/ gyur shog gi skabs su rten dang yon bdag la me tog gtor/ de la thog mar thams cad kyis/ ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis bsngo ba rgyas pa don gsal bzhin dang / bsdu na rang rang gi gang shes bsdus tsam bya/ da lan 'dir rje btsun rin po ches dgongs pa don gsal las cung zad bsdus te brjod na/ dgongs gsol spyi dang mthun/ sbyin pa'i bdag po dkon mchog gi rten la rab tu gnas pa sogs legs par bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa chos kyi dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshul bstan pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can rnams gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par༞ bdag cag dang sbyin bdag rnams kyis gtso byas sems can thams cad la ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlabs 'jug par༞ da lta zhal bzhugs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas 'dzin par mdzad pa thams cad sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe ring bar༞ rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las 'gro don dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par༞ phyogs bcu dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel zhing chos spyod bcu'i sgrub pa khyad par can rnams gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par༞ gzhan yang 'di ltar du sgrub pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pas gtso byas pa'i/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur tu thob par gyur cig

de ma thob kyi bar du yang mi khom pa brgyad spangs pa'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob par༞ mi'i lus kyang rigs bzang ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur cig longs spyod che ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu༞ de bzhin du tshe ring ba rnams kyi༞ nad med pa༞ shes rab che ba༞ skal ba bzang ba༞ dad pa che ba༞ rigs mtho ba༞ de ltar gyur nas kyang dam pa'i chos spyod pa la spro zhing skal ba dang ldan par༞ lan rnam par smin pa la re ba med pa'i sbyin pa rlabs po che gtong nus par༞ 'khor bar skye ba la 'dun pa dang bral ba'i tshul khrims rlabs po che bsrung nus par༞ sems can thams cad la zhe 'gras pa med pa'i bzod pa rlabs po che bsgom nus par༞ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag myur du bsdud pa'i brtson 'grus rlabs po che rtsom nus par༞ gzugs med pa'i khams rnam par gsal bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin mu mtha' med pa la mnyam par 'jog nus par༞ thabs snying rje chen po dang mi 'bral zhing shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don ston nus par༞ theg pa chen po zab pa dang rgya che ba ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mi 'bral bar༞ dge ba'i bshes gnyen de mnyes par byas nas des rjes su 'dzin par༞ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub sems kyi rtogs pa 'phel zhing rgyas par༞ lam bsgrub pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar༞ sems can thams cad la phan pa rgya chen po byed nus par༞ mthong ba'i chos tshe 'di nyid la'ang dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i nyes pa thams cad nye bar༞ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i gnod pa thams cad༞ rlung 'khris bad kan 'dus pa la sogs pa nad rigs bzhi'i gnod pa thams cad༞ rgyal po dang / dgra dang / chom rkun la sogs pa mi'i gnod pa thams cad༞ stag dang seng ge dang / glang po che la sogs pa'i gcan gzan gyi gnod pa thams cad༞ sa g.yo ba dang / skar mda' ltung ba dang / lce 'bab pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad༞

sa chu me rlung la sogs pa 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pa thams cad༞ rmi lam ngan pa/ mtshan pa ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad༞ mdor na bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing / tshe ring ba/ nad med pa/ longs spyod kyis brel ba med pa/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub par༞ mthar thug rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur tu thob par gyur cig skye ba kun tu༞ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal༞ phan bde 'byung ba'i༞ byang chub sems mchog rin po che༞ gtsug lag khang rnams༞ rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo pa༞ 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang༞ 'jig rten bde zhing༞ lha yang dus su༞ sman rnams mthu dang༞ sbyin bdag rnams kyi༞ bsod nams stobs chen༞ gzhan yang skye ba༞ bla med bla ma'i༞ ston pa 'jig rten khams su byon pa dang / /bstan pa nyi 'od bzhin du gsal ba dang / /bstan 'dzin bu slob chos spyod 'phel ba yis/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces brjod par bya'o/ /gshin po'i don du yin na gson bsngo'i rjes la/ rang rang gi blo la gshin bsngo gang yod rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la/ tshigs bcad kyang ji ltar rigs pa brjod do/ /de nas slob dpon mchod pa ni/ sbyin bdag gis slob dpon dang dge 'dun bsnyen bkur dang / ci 'byor pa'i yon skabs 'dir dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas dga' ston bya ba ni/ rab gnas rgyas par bya ba'i don du dpon slob rnams la dga' ston gyi rnyed bkur rgyas par bya zhing / sngar gyi tsa ru'i bza' ba lha la phul ba'i lhag ma'i 'brang rgyas kyi zan mchod g.yog pas dpon slob rnams la phul zhing / slob dpon sogs mi che ba rnams la/ bde bar gshegs pas gsol ba yi/ /lhag ma sdig pa 'joms pas bzhes/ /zhes pa dang / skye bo phal pa rnams la/ bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni/ /zo zhig sdig pa byang bar 'gyur/ /zhes 'brang rgyas kyi zan 'gyed pa la/

gang zag mchog dman gyi khyad par gyi 'don pa bsgyur lugs 'di bzhin byed pa rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris kyi rab gnas rnam bshad rnams las 'byung ba lags/ gzhan bzo bo dang / grogs byed pa dang / zhal lta ba dang nye 'khor sogs gnas khang de nyid dam/ gzhan du yang rung ste/ dga' ston che bar bya zhing / glu len pa dang / gar byed pa la sogs pa bkra shis pa'i yan lag phun sum tshogs par bya/ bkra mi shis pa'i gtam dang spyod pa sogs cung zad tsam yang ma byung ba bya dgos te/ de nas slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod pa ni/ dpon slob rnams kyis bsgrigs 'don mdzad de/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /sogs smon lam dang / de nas dbu zhwa rnams bzhes la dril bsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs dang / mtshungs med bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /sogs dang / gzhan yang bla ma yi dam chos srung nor lha sogs kyi bkra shis gang shes dang / nyin mo bde legs rol mo dang bcas bya zhing / bdag cag dpon slob sbyin bdag gis thog drangs/ sems can thams cad nyi ma dang zla ba gza' sgra gcan gyi kha nas thar ba bzhin du spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas/ bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal dam pa thob pa gcig tu gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog gi char dbab la yon mchod thams cad bkra shis par bya'o/ /de nas las kyi rjes bsdu ba ni/ dpon slob rnams kyi mnga' dbul dang / khrus stegs sogs bsdu zhing / las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya/ gtsug lag khang lta bu rab gnas kyi rten gnas de kar bzhugs pa yin na zhag bdun gyi bar du mchod pa rnams kha gsos shing rgyas par 'bul/ mchod ro rnams phongs pa dang mgon med pa'i 'gro ba la sbyin gyis/ khyi dang bya rog sogs la ni lhag mar dkor du 'gyur bas mi sbyin par bshad do/ /de nas rgyas pa la dga' bas sbyin sreg bya ba ni/

cho ga'i lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir/ mtshan mo zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya zhing / ma grub na dpon slob thams cad kyis yi ge brgya pa nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs lhag chad kha bskang bar bsam la brjod par bya'o/ /yang gang zag 'ga' zhig gi bsam pa la bkra shis sogs rgyas par byas pa'i rjes su/ yig brgya dang ma 'byor ba sogs tsam brjod pa 'di cho ga 'phro can lta bu'i yid snang la cung zad mi bde na/ ma byas kyang cho ga chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ba yin te/ rje btsun gyi rab gnas don gsal dang / rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po dang / kun mkhyen rin po che sogs/ rdo rje 'chang yab sras rnams kyi gsung rab las rab gnas kyi cho ga 'bring po'i skabs 'dir/ rjes bsdu yan chad bya bar bshad pa las sbyin sreg bya bar ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba las/ cho ga 'bring po'i skabs 'dir yang lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir sbyin sreg gam/ ma grub na yig brgya sogs brjod par gsungs pa dang mi 'gal lam snyam na/ de ni cho ga rgyas pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba dgongs pa yin gyi/ 'bring po'i phyogs la med mi rung du gsungs pa ni ma yin gyi/ dpyod ldan gzur gnas rnams kyis de ltar du rtogs par bya'o/ /ding sang gi rab gnas pa'i mchod yon rnams la bdag 'di ltar du gsol te/ rab tu gnas pa'i rdo rje slob dpon du 'os pa la/ rgyas par na don gsal nas 'byung ba'i slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid thams cad dang / de tsam mi ldan na yang / bde kye sogs bla med gang rung gi bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa zhig nges par dgos par bshad kyang / ding sang ni yon mchod rnams thugs mthun sdebs pa'i dge 'dun bzhi lnga sogs kyis rab gnas mdzad pa ma gtogs/ de'i slob dpon du 'os pa la bsnyen pa song ma song gi rtogs dpyod gang yang mi mdzad pa zhig yod pa 'dra ba/

de bzhin bgyis na phan yon las nyes dmigs che bar 'gyur bas/ deng phyin chad rab gnas pa dpon slob mang nyung ci mdzad kyang / de nyid rdo rje slob dpon la bsnyen pa las su rung ba re cis kyang yod pa mdzad zhu zhes/ bdag thal mo sbyar nas mchod yon thams cad la gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/ /de bzhin du rgyud sde zab mo nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi sgrub mchod kyi slob dpon yang / dkyil 'khor de dang de'i bsnyen pa las su rung ba'am/ de min na'ang bla med gang yang rung ba'i bsnyen pa tshad du 'khyol ba zhig nges par dgos pa yin yang / deng sang yo ga nas bshad pa'i kun rig sogs kyi sgrub mchod la cho ga thon pa tsam rtags su bkod nas/ bsnyen pa'i rigs gang yang ma song yang / sgrub mchod kyi slob dpon yun ring byed pa sogs 'dug pa/ 'di yang dge mi dge gang du 'gyur mi shes pas/ dpyod ldan gong ma'i gsung rab dri ma med pa rnams gzigs shing / blo gzu bor gnas pa dag gis/ bka' dang bstan bcos tshad ldan rnams kyi bshad tshod dang mthun pa zhig cis kyang mdzad 'tshal lo/ /de dag gis ni rab gnas kyi cho ga 'bring po'i lugs yongs su rdzogs pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ de ltar bshad pa'i rab gnas cho ga 'di/ /su yis mthong yang rnam dag phyag len khrigs/ /bde blag rtogs pas rang dang gzhan gyi don/ /'grub phyir 'di ni don gnyis lhun grub yin/ /mdo rgyud man ngag rig gnas rgya mtsho la/ /bla ma'i drin gyis blo gros mig gsal ba'i/ /skal bzang bdag la dad cing 'dun pa yi/ /dpyod ldan blo gsal kun gyi dga' ston yin/ /kho bo gzhon nu'i dus kyi bsam pa la/ /rab byung bsnyen rdzogs thos bsam ngom med spyad/ /grwa slob yon bdag mthun rkyen gang 'dzoms sar/ /mi tshe 'chad nyan sgrub la sgril snyam yang / /de lta na yang sngon bsags las kyi mthus/ /'khrul zad bla ma rnams kyi lung bstan bzhin/

/da ni mi theg bzhin du dpal sa skya'i/ /sde dang bstan pa'i khur gyis lus sems mnar/ /'on kyang phyi ltar 'phrin las rnam bzhi yis/ /bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin la rtag 'grus shing / /nang du bslu med bla mar blo gtad nas/ /rgyun du sdig bshags gsol 'debs la 'bad de/ /bdag gi bya ba spyod lam ci bgyis pa/ /kun kyang bstan 'gro'i don du gyur cig snyam/ /lhag bsam tsam la mchog tu re ba 'di/ /chos med bdag gi rgyun gyi nyams len lags/ /bdag 'dra lung rtogs yon tan kun bral yang / /dus mthar bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skal ba 'di/ /'gran bral bla ma mchog gi bka' drin las/ /gzhan du bsam pa bdag la cung zad med/ /de phyir dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa yi/ /rje btsun khyed la snying nas gsol 'debs kyi/ /bdag dang bdag la gcig tu yid gtad pa'i/ /'gro ba 'di kun byang chub bar du skyobs/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don kun/ /yid la re ba bzhin du mthar phyin nas/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rab rgyas shog /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /dpon slob lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /slar yang gang 'dul sprul pa sna tshogs kyis/ /srid mtha'i bar du bstan pa 'dzin par shog /don dam chos kun gdod nas spros bral zhing / /kun rdzob las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i mthus/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum dge bas bdag gi don/ /yid bzhin 'grub nas gzhan don kun 'grub shog /ces rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga don gnyis lhun grub blo gsal dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di yang / 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang po'i zhal snga nas dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i sangs rgyas dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po dang dbyer ma mchis pa rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa'i mkhas grub kyi bla ma du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/

dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rgya gar lugs la shuklaḥste dkar po zhes grags shing / rgya nag lugs la sa mo sbrul gyi lo'i smal po zla ba'i dmar cha rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi yang rtse sngar med gsar du bskrun pa'i gtsug lag khang ngo mtshar can li ma lha khang rdo rje gdan zhes bya ba dang / rgya nag lha khang ri bo rtse lngar grags pa'i bya 'dabs dpe khang chos mdzod chen mor sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ā k+ṣa ra'i 'du byed la mkhas pa'i mthar phyin pa gdong dga' pa tshe'i rig byed la byang chub cing rnam dpyod kyi blo gros rab tu gsal ba bsam pa don chen gyis bgyis so/ /'dis bstan pa dang sems can la 'phral dang yun du phan bde bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung zhing bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig kho bos byas pa'i rab gnas kyi yig cha 'di'i rgyab rten du/ rje btsun gyi don gsal dang / rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi gsung rab dang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba rnams la yang yang du blta bar gyis/ kal+yā na war+dhan+tu/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 44 a myes zhabs/ rab gnas kyi cho ga don gnyis lhun grub blo gsal dga' ston/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 43
